title: Depth Two Mock Modularity by Eisenstein Series Coupling
summary: The notion of depth two and higher mock modular forms have found important applications in mathematical physics and enumerative geometry since their inception through indefinite theta functions with general signature. These theta functions generalize Zwegers' work on Lorentzian signature lattices and the framework of mock modular forms that emanated from it. Mock modular forms can also be studied through Eisenstein and Poincaré series.
